summary: Reading a scare-monster scroll with a visible monster reaches read.c:seffect_scare_monster. JavaScript seffects records that whole effect as unported, so it omits the source-ordered zap.c:resist draw, possible monflee transition, and close-by laughter message. The queue annotates the C RNG callee resist, but the missing owner is read.c:seffect_scare_monster.

source.branch: For each living monster visible to the hero, the effect either clears frozen/fleeing/sleeping state when the hero is confused or the scroll is cursed, or consumes resist and, on failure, calls monflee. It counts visible nonpets; a scroll always emits laughter or wailing through You_hear, while SPE_CAUSE_FEAR emits it only when no nonpet was counted.
callers: C read.c:seffects dispatches SCR_SCARE_MONSTER and SPE_CAUSE_FEAR to seffect_scare_monster after doread or spellcasting; JS js/read.js:seffects has both arms but calls note_unported instead of the effect.
dependencies: The consumed return from zap.c:resist is already ported as js/zap.js:resist; preserve its SCROLL_CLASS or spell-object attack level and exact per-monster RNG order.
monmove.c:monflee is ported in js/monmove.js and must be awaited after a failed resistance check. vision.c:cansee is ported in js/vision.js.
C Soundeffect uses the recorder nosound backend and has no output; pline.c:You_hear behavior is available as js/monmove.js:youHear, with deaf, acoustics, underwater, and unaware guards.

evidence: The current saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260927142534-v8.json reports 48/49 screens and the first C RNG draw absent in JS at segment 0 step 47: rn2(108)=57 from zap.c:resist. The independent C recording at step 48 prints "You hear maniacal laughter close by."

A fresh read-only scan at published 56955495745cc647070474dbb74a558d5dfc2a24 records js/read.js note_unported(read.c seffect_scare_monster) and the same C resist draw at step 47, followed by the screen mismatch at step 48.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:seffect_scare_monster around lines 1454-1485 loops living visible monsters, calls resist only for the ordinary uncursed/unconfused path, then monflee when that result is false; it emits the heard message based on otyp, confused/cursed state, and visible nonpet count. js/read.js seffects arms at about line 1700 skip the function entirely.
The C trace’s resist label is a consumed callee, not the source owner of the omission; js/zap.js:resist already implements its full magic-resistance draw and return.
